noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

maxSize.description: The maximum number of entries in MRU caches.

ttr.description:
Time to Refresh: amount of time after which cached value will be refreshed _after_ access. Difference from #ttl is
fact that value is refreshed asynchronously vs synchronously on access in case of #ttl. Note that both #ttl and
#ttr can be set but #ttr should be less than #ttl. What this allows is that value access is not blocked by refresh
most of the time and there is a guarantee that value will always be up to date within #ttl time.

@see #ttl

refresh.description: If set cache will be primed on App.Node start and will refresh itself periodically.

dependencies.description:
List of C3 types that this cache is depending on.
   If a dependency type is invalidated, then this cache will be invalidated.

doNotCacheNulls.description: If `true` then will not cache the fact that that `Cache#produce` returned `null` for a `cache key`.

include.description: Include spec for persistable cached C3 types.

all.description: If true, then 'populateAll' will be called for any find operation where the cache is empty.

compile.description: If true, then cached static methods will be cached on the type itself during code-gen

softRef.description:
If `true`, then cached values will be held using soft references, allowing them to be garbage collected
when memory pressure is high. This is useful for caches that hold large objects or when memory efficiency
is more important than cache hit rate.

Note: When a soft-referenced value is garbage collected and subsequently re-computed, TTL/TTR timers
reset based on re-computation time, treating the value as freshly cached.

platPkg.description:
If `true`, then the cache instance type must be from the Jvm's `platform` package singleton instance. This ensures
that cache does not hold reference to any of the potentially transient application packages and types.
When a cached method or property is called, the returned instance will be remade using `Ctx.platPkg()`.
